title: fix(service-automation): no flow variable key reaches a prototype
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：流程的条件、取值、文本占位，以及流程试运行，读写变量时都遵守同一条规则，普通流程的行为不变。
- 这是安全席位派发的一项加固。
- 只影响一种特殊变量名，这种名字此前本来也读不到；出现意外可以直接撤回本 PR。
- 要你做什么：无。本 PR 没有申报收窄，契约审核 PASS 已在案，由席位直接落地。

## What changes

Rule: **no flow variable key reaches a prototype, and the containers a scope builder creates have none.**

- Every container the CEL scope builder and the text-hole scope builder create has no prototype, the root included.
- A variable key with a `__proto__` segment, in any position, binds nothing. It is skipped, not refused.
- The dry run's outbound payload writer follows the same rule. A path with a `__proto__` segment is written nowhere, and its walk descends through own properties only.

The rule is stated once, in `packages/services/service-automation/src/scope-key-segments.ts`. `celScope` (`dag-traversal.ts`), `textTemplateScope` (`builtin/template.ts`) and the dry-run payload writer (`dry-run.ts`) follow it.

**Skipped, not refused.** A refusal would fail every evaluation of the run, including predicates that never read the key. No CEL spelling read such a key before.

**`constructor` and `prototype` stay ordinary keys.** With prototype-free containers, and a walk that descends only into slots that hold an object, neither can leave the scope. Both are legal flow-variable names, and the `vars["prototype"]` remedy pinned in `value-slot-template-grammar.test.ts` still reads.

## Why

A no-card hardening order from the security seat. The details stay with the seat.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/cel-scope-key-segments.test.ts`: each half of the rule at each builder, with literal cases. Controls: `step.result` still nests and a condition reads it; `vars['$error']`, `has()`, `vars["prototype"]`, a bare `constructor`, `step.prototype` and `record.prototype` still read.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/dry-run.test.ts`: the dry-run payload writer follows the rule, with a control beside it.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-condition-scope-keys.dogfood.test.ts`: a real boot through a plain member's public doors, with a control.

Every new pin is red on the base and green after. Each guard was ablated, its pins went red, and it was restored to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- Pre-existing, not changed here: a variable or output key named `constructor` makes reads through the container that holds it fault with `Unsupported type: object`. Carried as its own follow-up.
- Pre-existing, not changed here: a dry run mis-addresses an authored map key that contains a dot, ends in an index, or is empty. This is a payload-accuracy defect, carried as its own follow-up.

## Verification

- CI on the head: every required check is green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test` and `typecheck` pass. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` passes.
- The full dogfood battery is green on the final head.
- Contract review: PASS on the head (security seat).

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's repo-wide run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (A no-card order: one order, one branch, one pull request.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
